prompt: Create one production UI mouse cursor asset for the Brundlefly organic horror lair website, using the supplied canonical artwork only as a palette and tissue/style reference. Four or fewer large visual masses, strong legible silhouette at 32 to 48 pixels. Not a hand, not a full mascot, no extra characters. Fill the square canvas with the single cursor icon, leaving only a narrow transparent margin. Point extends toward the top left; wide bottom right root. Alpha cutout must be clean.
